title: Paige Kaye (Founder & CEO, PaigeKares) enters a $100K founder competition as a solopreneur — 'I can eat glass a little longer until I identify the right investors/partners'
summary: Paige Kaye is going to Stan Launchpad to build her childcare company in public and compete for $100,000 against thirty founder teams. She announces it by naming the terms she won't trade, and credits the book for the patience: she'd rather stay bootstrapped than take money from the wrong people. She called every client personally before saying yes.
blockquote:
All of my PK fam knows that I will NEVER compromise our mission, trust, safety, or #kare for anything💚 

(Eric Ries’s book “Incorruptible” is a big inspiration of mine and reminds me that I can eat glass a little longer until I identify the right investors/partners for PaigeKares)
